statement: ∀ (q t : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 ≤ q → 0 < t → (N : ℝ) * t ≤ 2 → (N : ℝ≥0∞) * (ENNReal.ofReal t) ^ (q + 1) ≤ 2 * (ENNReal.ofReal t) ^ q
proof:
intro q t N hq ht hN
rw [ENNReal.rpow_add_of_nonneg q 1 hq zero_le_one, ENNReal.rpow_one]
calc
  (N : ℝ≥0∞) * (ENNReal.ofReal t ^ q * ENNReal.ofReal t) =
      ((N : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal t) * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ q := by ring
  _ ≤ 2 * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ q := by
    apply mul_le_mul' _ le_rfl
    have hc : (N : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal t = ENNReal.ofReal ((N : ℝ) * t) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg N)]
      simp
    rw [hc]
    exact_mod_cast ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hN

checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (BasisObjects.Rn n)),
  (∀ (X : Type u_1) [inst : MetricSpace X] (A : Set X) (a : ℝ),
      0 < a →
        (∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ) A = ⨅ U, ⨅ (_ : RealCover δ A U), realCost a U) ∧
          (∀ (ι : Type u_2) [Countable ι] (V : ι → Set X),
              ∃ e U,
                (∀ (k : ι), U (e k) = V k) ∧
                  (∀ i ∉ range ⇑e, U i = ∅) ∧ ⋃ i, U i = ⋃ k, V k ∧ cost a U = cost a V ∧ realCost a U = realCost a V) ∧
            (∀ (δ₁ δ₂ : ℝ),
                0 < δ₁ →
                  δ₁ ≤ δ₂ →
                    BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ₂) A ≤ BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ₁) A) ∧
              (∀ (δ : ℝ) (U : ℕ → Set X),
                  0 < δ → Cover δ A U → BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ) A ≤ cost a U) ∧
                (∀ (δ : ℝ) (b : ℝ≥0∞),
                    0 < δ →
                      (∀ (U : ℕ → Set X), Cover δ A U → b ≤ cost a U) →
                        b ≤ BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ) A) ∧
                  H a A = ⨆ δ, ⨆ (_ : 0 < δ), BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ) A ∧
                    (∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ) A ≤ H a A) ∧
                      (∀ (δ : ℝ),
                          0 < δ →
                            (BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ) A = 0 ↔
                              ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ U, Cover δ A U ∧ cost a U < ENNReal.ofReal ε)) ∧
                        (H a A = 0 ↔
                          ∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ U, Cover δ A U ∧ cost a U < ENNReal.ofReal ε)) →
    ∀ (q t : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 ≤ q → 0 < t → ↑N * t ≤ 2 → ↑N * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ (q + 1) ≤ 2 * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ q
